label: An actual root exists, from the Cogito necessary thinking root
meaning: The premise b401eca0 gives a bearer b of an occurring thought and one n that thinks, is a ground ancestor of b, is an actual root of the selected relation at w (concrete, existing at w, with no actual concrete ground there) and exists at every world accessible from w. Keeping only the rootness clause gives ActualRootExistsAt at the same profile and world: some actual concrete root exists at w. Thinking, ancestry and de re necessity are dropped, so the conclusion says nothing about a thinker, necessity, uniqueness or God. The step is a projection; its interest is the support option it opens for the root-path input dc397705, whose warrant here runs through the Cogito route: an occurring thought with a concrete bearer existing at w and the thinker-local premises (accessible thinking ancestry debcd4e1, grounding of contingent thinking cone members db72222b, earlier distinct thinking predecessors and excluded middle) in place of a global population, roster or well-foundedness premise. Sense bridge: b401eca0 states rootness as the absence of an actual concrete ground (WELL_FOUNDEDNESS_AND_ANTI_BRUTE_ROOT_1); ActualRoot (_2) is defined from that absence, and the premise carries both about the same n.
